lane: AI runtime: server-side daily limits for persona chat and Tarot AI (AI-02)
goal: Finish the Phase 2 AI cost guard. Persona chat and Tarot AI already require sign-in but have no server-side limit, so one account can call a paid model without bound. Apply the decisions in force: Chat+Oracle 5 per local day (Oracle does not call a model yet, so persona chat carries the whole allowance) and Tarot AI 1 per local day for every account (Owner 04/11). Like Astrology AI, only a delivered (validated) Tarot reading uses up the day; failed attempts are capped so provider failures cannot run up cost.
successCriteria: ai-persona-chat answers 429 daily_limit_reached once 5 model attempts were recorded for that account since local midnight (UTC+7); a safety redirect and a paused switch answer before any attempt is counted.

ai-tarot-reading answers 429 daily_limit_reached when the account already has a validated AI reading today, or has made 3 attempts today (1 delivered + 2 failed allowance); each allowed call records one attempt event before the model call.
A failed count or record answers 503 usage_check_unavailable and does not call the model.
Both functions pass deno check; the shared policy and daily-attempt tests pass; the app tests that cover these calls still pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL and no use of the unapplied nilaza_private reservation tables (20261002000000_ai_usage_reservation.sql stays disabled).
No app change in this slice: on 429 the app already shows its local Tarot reading or local chat reply; a clear 'come back tomorrow' message and a remaining-turns badge are the next app slice.
No deploy: both functions are redeployed only after the Owner approves.

impact.dataWrite: One usage_events row per allowed attempt (persona_message_attempted, tarot_reading_attempted) under existing own-row RLS; Tarot reads own tarot_readings rows to count delivered readings.
impact.backendContract: Success responses unchanged; new 429 daily_limit_reached and 503 usage_check_unavailable.
impact.adminVisibility: Attempt events visible in usage data; workflow catalog digests refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: Counts only; no message, question or card text in the attempt rows. Safety redirects in chat still answer when the limit is reached.
impact.observability: Existing traces unchanged; attempt events give per-day counts.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous version.

managerTestPath: After an approved deploy: signed in, the 6th chat message of the day and a second Tarot AI reading after a delivered one return 429 and the app shows its local text.
residualRisk: Two simultaneous requests can both pass the count and exceed the limit by one. Persona chat 5 messages per day is tight; the Owner may raise it in the policy file. Until the next app slice the user sees local text rather than a 'come back tomorrow' message.
